project_type: Bilingual school academic follow-up / assessment web app
purpose: Track weekly follow-up marks, quizzes, chapter tests, quarter exams, performance levels, analytics, and admin reports for Al Anjal National Schools

auth: Optional Google ID token + mandatory first-use Admin Gmail approval

key_features: Independent pre-test/diagnostic total entry, variable maxima, >=75 / >=50 performance bands, revision-safe Excel import and snapshot-protected PDF/Excel export
Teacher profiles, fail-closed Gmail approval, and Admin password-change alerts
EN/AR RTL UI with PageHero banners
International/Arabic Section switching with isolated records
Arabic quarter grading out of 100: entered-week average /40 plus best theory /30 and one practical /30, with stage-aware raw maxima and three-test completion analytics
Arabic weekly continuous entry in student management: four /10 components, weeks 1-9 and 10-18, promotion, student actions, and class-first analytics
Multi-year approved school PDF calendar import with preserved history and automatic current-year resolution
Section/year-isolated weekly timetable inside both section Dashboards

commands.frontend_build_windows: cd frontend; $env:DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN="true"; npm exec -- craco build; node scripts/postbuild-spa.cjs

verified_baseline.backend_dependencies: Installed from backend/requirements.txt; pip check passed
verified_baseline.backend_focused_tests: All 83 backend tests passed after Gmail/provider-bound JWT security hardening; the legacy live Mongo connection utility remains manually runnable and is excluded from unit-test discovery
verified_baseline.pdf_smoke: International quarter + semester/midterm and Arabic quarter passed; Amiri embedded and no blank pages
verified_baseline.frontend_tests: 15 suites / 97 tests passed, including exact-Admin settings/navigation visibility and notification polling coverage
verified_baseline.frontend_build: Windows-equivalent CRACO build and existing postbuild completed successfully
verified_baseline.live_integration_tests: not run; require external credentials and may touch live services

owner_preferences: Full redesigns when requested, not tiny cosmetics only
Preserve score calculations while improving presentation
Arabic and RTL must work including PDFs
Commit and push to main for Render when asked
protected_behaviors: Quarter total out of 50 scoring pipeline
Amiri-embedded Arabic text in Analytics/Reports PDFs (reward certificates are a known exception)
Every first-use Google identity/link remains unable to enter through Gmail until exact Admin approval; rejecting a link preserves an existing local-password account
attendance field is weekly score max 2.5 not roll-call
Arabic attendance is a weekly grading component max 10, not roll-call
Arabic performance thresholds proportionally mirror International bands: weekly /40 at 34.6667/26.6667 and quarter /100 at 92/86
Legacy user schedules remain current-year International; Arabic timetables use scoped records only
Score-sheet imports preview before apply, write one explicitly allowed attempt only, and never import practical scores or create enrollment records
high_risk_areas: Bulk score save and Excel import mapping
PDF font embedding and chart axis Arabic
known_issues: The 1448H approved school PDF contains three visibly malformed source entries that remain flagged for manual review
design_guidelines.json partially outdated vs live UI
Reward certificates use Helvetica/direct text and are not yet Arabic-safe
Normal npm run build is not Windows-portable because it uses POSIX environment-variable syntax
npm ci reports 58 dependency vulnerabilities; automatic fixes/upgrades require explicit approval
Live MongoDB/login/integration tests are excluded from the safe offline baseline
Weekly report configuration uses a separate report_settings collection

scoring_summary.arabic_exam_model: best of theory_test_1/theory_test_2 weighted to 30 plus practical_test weighted to 30
